description: Add units to a workspace you already hold. Send its API key in _meta[satledger/api-key] (or the api_key argument) and the payment in _meta[x402/payment]: 0.50 USDC for 2,500 units (starter), 15.00 USDC for 100,000 units (block). The units land in that workspace and nothing new is created; buying a workspace instead gives you an empty ledger under a different key.

api_key.description: Your workspace key, if your client cannot set _meta[satledger/api-key]. Prefer _meta: arguments are logged by most clients.

name: top_up_workspace
title: satledger top-up
